title: Under What Conditions Can a Machine Become Genuinely Creative? A Designics-Based Requirement Framework for Creative Machine and Human–AI Co-Living
reasoning: The paper explicitly integrates 'proactive AI ethics' as a core structural requirement for genuine machine creativity (Section 7). It argues that ethical, value-based scoping (R9) must be internal to the creative process rather than an external filter, and evaluates the framework's ethical operationalization.
